label: Saved views
description: A set of named, predefined filters and sorts for the data table in the same column or tab, shown as tabs above the table — for example "My open", "Unassigned", "P1". The first view is the default.
usage: Offer 3–6 views that match how people work their queue.
Name views by what they show ("Unassigned"), not who uses them.
Use user.id in filters for personal views ("My open").
constraints: Must share a column or tab with a collection.data_table; at most 20 views with unique ids.
filter is a CEL-subset expression over record and user; sort.field must be a sortable field of the table's entity.
Views only narrow results; they never widen what the viewer may read.

binding.description: Replaces the sibling data table's base filter and sort with the selected view's.

accessibility.keyboard: Left/Right arrows move between views; Enter or Space selects.
accessibility.notes: The selected view is aria-selected and reflected in the URL.

responsive: Below 720px the views become a single select.
